provenance.title: Critical and Emerging Technologies List Update
provenance.publisher: Fast Track Action Subcommittee on Critical and Emerging Technologies, National Science and Technology Council, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP)
provenance.note: Downloaded and read directly (the real PDF, not a summary). All 18 categories' subfields are bare 2-4 word technical terms -- zero prose description anywhere in the source document, for any category or subfield. Each category below is embedded as ONE passage concatenating all of its subfield terms together, not per-subfield, to give the embedding more than a 2-3 word fragment to work with. Treated as a secondary, explicitly lower-confidence signal relative to the DoD corpus -- never pooled with it in one ranking (see docs/plans/2026-09-01-vss-topic-similarity-layer.md's binding acceptance criterion 1).

technology_areas.name: Advanced Computing
subfields: Advanced supercomputing, including for AI applications
High-performance data storage and data centers

technology_areas.name: Advanced Engineering Materials
subfields: Materials by design and material genomics
Materials with novel properties to include substantial improvements to existing properties
Novel and emerging techniques for material property characterization and lifecycle assessment

technology_areas.name: Advanced Gas Turbine Engine Technologies
subfields: Aerospace, maritime, and industrial development and production technologies
Full-authority digital engine control, hot-section manufacturing, and associated technologies

technology_areas.name: Advanced and Networked Sensing and Signature Management
subfields: Detection and characterization of pathogens and of chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear weapons and materials

technology_areas.name: Advanced Manufacturing
subfields: Advanced manufacturing technologies and techniques including those supporting clean, sustainable, and smart manufacturing, nanomanufacturing, lightweight metal manufacturing, and product and material recovery

technology_areas.name: Artificial Intelligence
subfields: Generative AI systems, multimodal and large language models
Synthetic data approaches for training, tuning, and testing
Technologies for improving AI safety, trust, security, and responsible use

technology_areas.name: Biotechnologies
subfields: Novel synthetic biology including nucleic acid, genome, epigenome, and protein synthesis and engineering, including design tools
Multi-omics and other biometrology, bioinformatics, computational biology, predictive modeling, and analytical tools for functional phenotypes
Engineering of sub-cellular, multicellular, and multi-scale systems
Engineering of viral and viral delivery systems

technology_areas.name: Clean Energy Generation and Storage
subfields: Renewable and sustainable chemistries, fuels, and feedstocks

technology_areas.name: Data Privacy, Data Security, and Cybersecurity Technologies
subfields: Digital identity technologies, biometrics, and associated infrastructure
Technologies for data fusion and improving data interoperability, privacy, and security
Security and privacy technologies in augmented reality/virtual reality

technology_areas.name: Highly Automated, Autonomous, and Uncrewed Systems (UxS), and Robotics
subfields: Supporting digital infrastructure, including High Definition (HD) maps

technology_areas.name: Integrated Communication and Networking Technologies
subfields: Radio-frequency (RF) and mixed-signal circuits, antennas, filters, and components

technology_areas.name: Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) Technologies
subfields: Diversified PNT-enabling technologies for users and systems in airborne, space-based, terrestrial, subterranean, and underwater settings
Interference, jamming, and spoofing detection technologies, algorithms, analytics, and networked monitoring systems

technology_areas.name: Quantum Information and Enabling Technologies
subfields: Materials, isotopes, and fabrication techniques for quantum devices

technology_areas.name: Semiconductors and Microelectronics
subfields: Design and electronic design automation tools
Manufacturing process technologies and manufacturing equipment
Specialized/tailored hardware components for artificial intelligence, natural and hostile radiation environments, RF and optical components, high-power devices, and other critical applications
Novel architectures for non-Von Neumann computing

technology_areas.name: Space Technologies and Systems
subfields: In-space servicing, assembly, and manufacturing as well as enabling technologies
Technology enablers for cost-effective on-demand, and reusable space launch systems
Technologies that enable access to and use of cislunar space and/or novel orbits
Sensors and data analysis tools for space-based observations
Resilient and path-diverse space communication systems, networks, and ground stations
Space launch, range, and safety technologies
